name: Typography Scale Generator
description: Generates a font-size type scale from a base size and a named or numeric ratio (e.g. Major Third, Perfect Fourth).

tools.name: generate_type_scale
tools.description: Generates a type scale of font sizes (px and rem) from a base size, a numeric or named ratio, and a step count.

baseSizePx.description: Base font size in px. Default 16.

ratio.description: Numeric ratio, or a named ratio: minorSecond, majorSecond, minorThird, majorThird, perfectFourth, goldenRatio. Default 1.25.

steps.description: Number of steps in the scale. Default 6.
